svg.data-poe-current-limit: 1.1 A per port at input below 30 V, 0.56 A above; 5.4 A total
svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, two inputs, two built-in supplies
svg.data-power-rating-label: 100-240 V ~1 A MAX 50/60 Hz (printed under each inlet)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: brochure: the two SFP+ cages give 10G fibre uplinks; no module is included
svg.data-usb: USB 3.0 type A, 1 A maximum, USB power reset
